01_top10_creators_to_listen.definition: Creators whose videos in this lane, with channel evidence, not a popularity guess
01_top10_creators_to_listen.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

02_top10_outlier_videos.definition: Videos with outlier_ratio >=3.0 vs channel 30d median, only if >=3 channel videos in DB, else UNVERIFIED
02_top10_outlier_videos.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

03_top10_best_videos_past_week.definition: Top by views and engagement ratio in the lane, from scored snapshots only
03_top10_best_videos_past_week.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

04_top10_best_channels_growth.definition: Channels with steepest subscriber velocity AND upload consistency, only if both are in evidence
04_top10_best_channels_growth.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

05_top10_incumbent_changelogs.definition: Incumbent changelog entries this week, with date and diff
05_top10_incumbent_changelogs.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

06_top10_rising_companies.definition: Seed/stealth tools with a dated launch signal (Product Hunt / HN / release), not a vibe
06_top10_rising_companies.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

07_top10_industry_watchouts.definition: Deprecations, rate cuts, lawsuits, price surges, each with a dated source
07_top10_industry_watchouts.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

08_top10_search_queries.definition: Autosuggest / seed query tree, from the lane CSV + actual search terms used, labelled as queries used, not as demand
08_top10_search_queries.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

09_top10_trending_github_repos.definition: Repos by 7-day star velocity under topic:ai-tools and lane topics
09_top10_trending_github_repos.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

10_top10_production_tools.definition: Tools with daily-active evidence (release, usage post, or Oliver's own use), not a vendor claim alone
10_top10_production_tools.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

11_top10_diy_builds.definition: Teardowns Oliver can build live in <4h, with a real artifact named
11_top10_diy_builds.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

12_top10_workflows_and_reasons.definition: top_10_workflows + top_10_reasons_to_care, each tied to a dimension 01-11 item
12_top10_workflows_and_reasons.count_rule: List only items with evidence. Never pad to 10.

inference.rule: Top topic needs >=2 independent evidence sources. Single-source topics are marked single-source, do not lead with.
